items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: And I played with the old man Rube Show.

ctx.x: All of them. Monk Johnson. That's before my time. I was a baby. Yeah. I was a young baby then. I was a young baby. I saw my daddy play twice in my life. My uncle. My uncle and my dad were playing the same band. And I played with the old man Rube Show. Oh. I was a great man. I also played with Rube Show. Which I didn't know. And what else is there?
Well, I'm glad to know about that because you know I never knew much about your uncle or your father at all. I'm saying that.
